A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same M2CL study and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H. Material can be reliably matched despite changes in pagination.

before.justification: Section 6 and Appendix G report original benchmark accuracies, scaling experiments, ablations, transfer experiments, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results in Section 6 and Appendix G, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, transfer experiments, and runtime measurements.

M1.justification: Sections 3–5 and Algorithm 1 retain the same context initialization, per-agent instruction generators, activation-based objectives, adaptive weighting, and majority-vote inference. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MMLU, MATH, GPQA, HumanEval, ALFWorld, SciWorld, GAIA, PDDL, and AndroidWorld. The represented reasoning, embodied/tool-use, and mobile GUI tasks remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Single, BoN, Debate, DyLAN, GPTSwarm, and MacNet in Tables 1 and 4–9. Table 3 also retains its Qwen-Max and GPT-4 comparisons. Newly cited works are not added experimental comparators.

E3.justification: The training/test split, model configurations, agent counts, metrics, and Table 2 training settings are unchanged. Figure 23's corrected labels match the experiment already described as varying the number of LLMs in Appendix G.7.3; they do not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: The context-constraint sensitivity tests, discrepancy analyses, transfer experiments, training-convergence analysis, component ablations, runtime studies, and Appendix H case studies are retained. Figure 23's labeling correction adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report standard deviations over three seeds in Figure 4 and relevant appendix figures, including Figure 23. Run-count disclosures, uncertainty reporting, and error bars remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables, plotted outcomes, and case-study findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains four-agent Qwen-7B MATH accuracy of 47.8% and GPQA accuracy of 66.1%. Figure 23 changes axis labels and ticks, while preserving runtime bars and error bars.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives, Theorem 4.1, supporting lemmas and proofs in Appendices B–D, and the multiround optimization derivation in Appendix E are unchanged.

C1.justification: Both versions make the same core claims about learned per-agent contexts, diverse initialization, improved consensus and scaling, 20%–50% performance advantages, transferability, and computational efficiency. The contribution statements retain their meaning and scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of diversity versus consensus, component ablations, scaling, and transfer remain unchanged. Section 7 retains the same computational-efficiency limitation, and the ethics statement preserves its qualifications about bias and error propagation.

D1.justification: The Reproducibility Statement replaces the anonymous code link with the GitHub repository already listed in v1's first-page footnote and newly provides a Hugging Face checkpoint location. Appendix F's implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds eight references: Wang et al. (2023), Wu et al. (2025), Yu et al. (2025), and Yue et al. (2024a–e). Citations are inserted into existing introduction, related-work, and Section 5.2.1 passages without substantially revising the research positioning or novelty argument.

P1.justification: Limited edits include an abstract grammar correction, an updated affiliation and publication header, added acknowledgments, and unnumbered ethics and reproducibility headings. The scientific narrative and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 23 replaces 'Model Size' with 'Number of LLMs' and corrects lower-row ticks from model sizes to 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. Figure 3 moves from page 9 to page 8, and Figure 4 shifts within page 9. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects misleading Figure 23 axis labels and adds explicit checkpoint access information, improving interpretability and reproducibility documentation. These are limited gains: the methods, theory, empirical evidence, and stated limitations remain unchanged.
